response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, but their profile centers on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than the deep, hands-on C++ expertise this role requires. C++ exposure is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a thesis project, with no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL practices, MQTT/industrial protocols, or industrial automation domain experience. Adjacent strengths in low-latency systems (DLang) and event-driven architectures don't offset the core skills gap for a C++-focused industrial role.
strengths: Extensive senior-level engineering experience across web, backend, and embedded systems
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby
Strong quality mindset: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools authorship, mentoring and workshops
concerns: Minimal and dated professional C++ experience (~6 months, ended 2015)
No industrial automation, IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial-protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT) background
Recent career trajectory is full-stack web/AI tooling, diverging from the role's systems focus
